title: 140 GHz research_sub_thz pre-change baseline
scope: Read-only capture of the existing Go evaluator before Concept 4I.1 audit artifacts and tests.

source_equation_ledger.research_evaluator: research_sub_thz delegates to legacyPropagationTerms and propagationResultFromTerms; it does not use LOS/NLOS, building height, diffraction, gas, rain, cloud, clutter, vegetation, or a measured channel model.
source_equation_ledger.current_penetration_rule: frequency < 10 GHz: 8 dB; 10 <= frequency < 100 GHz: 30 dB; frequency >= 100 GHz: 80 dB per footprint event
source_equation_ledger.current_link_budget_dbm: P_rx = P_tx_conducted + G_tx_boresight - A_tx_pattern + G_rx - L_system - L_polarization + calibration - L_propagation - L_building

geometry_cases.interpretation: No footprint boundary event; no height obstruction is supplied.
One footprint obstruction represented by the legacy event counter.
One facade/boundary crossing; numerically identical to any one-event case.
Entry and exit boundaries; the current heuristic sums two independent 80 dB events.
Known roof obstruction; the research evaluator does not consume the height evidence.
Unknown-height footprint obstruction; the research evaluator still applies the event count and does not distinguish this state numerically.

observations: The current profile is numerically FSPL plus a cumulative frequency threshold heuristic; it is not a validated 140 GHz urban channel model.
At the default 25 m / 1.5 m endpoint heights, the evaluator uses slant distance, so the 10 m ground-distance sample has a 25.539186 m slant distance.
The LOS label, height-aware obstruction state, and unknown-height state do not change the research_sub_thz numeric result when wall_event_count is held constant.
One footprint event already places the 100 m sample at -140.606011 dBm under this profile; two events place it at -220.606011 dBm.
The receiver threshold is returned as the existing manual -115 dBm planning threshold; this is not a 140 GHz receiver or radio-quality validation claim.

capture_validation.audit_note: The audit test was added after the baseline commit and asserts these values without changing production RF code.
